data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aikaterina, meaning 'pure'. The name Katey has been popular in the English-speaking world for centuries, with various spellings and pronunciations. The name Katey carries the meaning “Pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katey usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
